title: How Much Time Should I Take Between Jobs?
description:
Transitioning from job to job is a stressful time. Do I start immediately? Do I take a month to cool down from my last job? Really, there is no right answer, and this topic tends to be subjective amongst those transitioning to a new role. However, on this episode of the Teal Podcast, we discuss how much time you should be taking between positions, and factors to consider when deciding.
